notes: Capsule-cache microbench timings are focused solver-call costs, not whole-frame timings.
cape_solver_off retains cape equipment and meshes while bypassing simulation; its resulting pose is not claimed equivalent to production.
Both accepted crowd reports use attribution and a per-frame cape activity observer and are excluded from acceptance aggregation.
Shared-host drift and two-run order sensitivity make the crowd delta descriptive only.
Native presentation was disabled; native spell-flight source was present in provenance but was not built into or invoked through the recorded older DLL.
